scope: Read-only source-preservation audit after full Korean content promotion; only this evidence document and temporary audit script were written.
method: Parsed every changed content YAML except locales.yaml; recursively removed only mapping keys exactly equal to ko, preserved array order, sorted object keys, and compared all remaining values.
Classified every changed tracked and untracked path under content/, src/i18n/messages/, and public/media/. Only Korean MDX/messages and localized YAML fields are allowed.
Used Git byte-diff against the fixed base for all tracked original bodies, non-Korean prose/messages and media; no lossy normalization was used for these protected files.
Compared registry excluding the Korean locale entry to detect unrelated policy changes.
